newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield gets U.S. airport contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield gets U.S. airport contract.

text.p: Shopping centre operator Westfield Holdings Ltd said it had been selected to develop, lease, market and manage the retail space at a large terminal at the Boston Logan international airport in Massachusetts, United States.
Westfield said the contract was awarded by the Massachusetts Port Authority for Terminal C at the Boston airport which is used by more than eight million passengers a year.

It said it would carry out the development of the retail space in the main terminal as well as in the gate areas as part of a modernisation programme for the whole airport, with the work on Terminal C to be completed towards the end of 1997.
Westfield said it is currently developing and managing the retail projects at the National Airport and the Dulles International Airport in Washington D.C.
Westfield shares closed three cents stronger at A$19.75.
